title: Torsors under the comparison inverse image of a group sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $G_0$ a possibly noncommutative group sheaf on its small etale site. Use the etale torsors $P$ and their actions of [def-constructible-torsor]. Write $L=\nu_X^*$ for the canonical set-sheaf inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and write $\underline G_0$ for the underlying set sheaf. Its multiplication $m_0$ and identity $e_0$ are the sectionwise group operations. On $G=L\underline G_0$ define $m=L(m_0)\circ c^{-1}$ and $e=L(e_0)\circ c_\varnothing^{-1}$, where $c:L(A\times B)\cong LA\times LB$ and $c_\varnothing:L(*)\cong *$ are the canonical finite-product comparisons. A comparison torsor is a set sheaf $T$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and a sheaf morphism $a:G\times T\to T$ satisfying the identity and associativity laws for $e,m$, such that for every object $U$ and section $t\in T(U)$ the function $g\mapsto a(g,t)$ from $G(U)$ to $T(U)$ is bijective, and every object has a covering by objects where $T$ has a section. For an etale $G_0$-torsor $P$ with action $a_P$, define its inverse-image action on $LP$ by $L(a_P)\circ c^{-1}$. A model isomorphism $\alpha:LP\cong T$ is a sheaf isomorphism intertwining that action and $a$. A trivialization of $T$ over $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is a family of bijections $T(V)\cong G(V)$ for every morphism $V\to U$, natural under further restriction and intertwining $a$ with left multiplication $m$. All group-section sets, torsor-section sets and comparison colimits lie in the common larger site universe.
